name: pAIchart MCP Hub
description: AI-native service orchestration platform. Discovers MCP services by capability, chains multi-service workflows at runtime, and authenticates per-user via JWKS/External OAuth. 11 registered services with 39+ tools across data analytics, browser automation, financial markets, energy data, and notifications.

skills.name: MCP Service Discovery
skills.description: Find registered MCP services by capability, category, or description. Returns service metadata, tool schemas, and health status. Use: services(action: "discover")
examples: What services are available?
Find services with monitoring capabilities
Show me data analytics tools

skills.name: Multi-Service Workflow Execution
skills.description: Chain multiple MCP services into sequential, parallel, or conditional workflows with variable passing between steps. Use: services(action: "workflow.execute")
examples: Get electricity prices for Texas and email me a summary
Scrape this page and send the results to Slack
Query Snowflake and create a notification with the results

skills.name: MCP Service Registration
skills.description: Register new MCP services with the Hub via a single command. Automatic capability indexing, trust level assignment, and health monitoring. Use: registry(action: "register") or /prompt register_guide
examples: Register my MCP service at https://my-service.com/mcp
How do I add my service to the Hub?

skills.name: Per-User Snowflake Query
skills.description: Execute read-only SQL queries on Snowflake data warehouse, authenticated as the requesting user via External OAuth. Every query is attributed to the real user in Snowflake audit logs.
examples: Show me the top tables in my Snowflake warehouse
Run a query on the sales database
Describe the schema of the customers table

skills.name: Browser Automation
skills.description: Web scraping, screenshots, PDF generation, form filling, and JavaScript execution via Playwright.
examples: Take a screenshot of this webpage
Scrape the pricing table from competitor.com
Generate a PDF of this report

skills.name: Financial Market Data
skills.description: Real-time stock quotes, historical OHLCV data, company fundamentals, and ticker search via EODHD and Alpha Vantage (113+ tools).
examples: Get the current price of AAPL
Show me Tesla's fundamentals
Compare historical prices of MSFT and GOOG

skills.name: U.S. Energy Data Analytics
skills.description: Electricity generation, capacity, pricing, and energy storage opportunity analysis across all U.S. states via EIA data.
examples: Compare electricity prices between Texas and California
Find high-potential energy storage areas
Show the generation mix for New York

skills.name: Multi-Channel Notifications
skills.description: Send notifications via email (Brevo), Slack, and webhooks. Supports broadcast (multi-channel), escalation chains, and scheduled delivery.
examples: Send an email summary to the team
Broadcast an alert to Slack and email
Schedule a notification for tomorrow

authentication.credentials: Obtain via OAuth 2.0 (GitHub, Google, Microsoft) at https://paichart.app
